entries.source: #Target# is being being removed from the timeline!
entries.target: #Target#被从时间线中除去！

entries.source: The target is surrounded by a stone shield absorbing %d/%d damage.  When the shield is removed, it will explode for up to %d (currently %d) Arcane damage in a radius %d.
entries.target: 目标被一层岩石护盾围绕，吸收 %d/%d 点伤害。护盾消失时会爆炸，对半径 %d 内的目标造成至多 %d（当前 %d）点奥术伤害。

entries.source: , %d%% bleeding, poison, disease, and stun immunity
entries.target: ，获得 %d%% 流血、毒素、疾病及震慑免疫

entries.source: The target is hexed, granting it %d%% chance each turn to be dazed for 3 turns.
entries.target: 目标受邪术影响，每回合有 %d%% 概率眩晕 3 回合。

entries.source: The target is hexed.  Each time it uses an ability it takes %0.2f fire damage, and talent cooldowns are increased by %s plus 1 turn.
entries.target: 目标受邪术影响，每次施放技能都会受到 %0.2f 火焰伤害，技能冷却延长 %s 另加 1 回合。

entries.source: You resisted a Lich and are immune to its frightening presence.
entries.target: 你抵抗了一名巫妖，并免疫它的恐怖存在效果。

entries.source: When a ghoul is hit or dies, it explodes, doing %0.2f frostdusk damage.
entries.target: 当食尸鬼被击中或死亡，它会爆炸，造成 %0.2f 霜暮伤害。

entries.source: The target is infected by a plague, doing %0.2f darkness damage per turn with a %d%% chance to rip apart the soul.
entries.target: 目标被瘟疫感染，每回合受到 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并有 %d%% 几率撕裂其灵魂。

entries.source: The target is on fire, taking %0.2f fire damage per turn and %d%% chance per turn of removing a physical or magical effect from all targets affected by Inferno, Burning Wake or Cleansing Flames.
entries.target: 目标受到灼烧效果，每回合受到 %0.2f 火焰伤害，并每回合有 %d%% 几率移除被地狱火、无尽之焰或净化之焰影响的生物身上的一个物理或魔法效果。

entries.source: The target will gain a shield upon suffering a detrimental effect
entries.target: 目标受到负面状态效果时，获得护盾

entries.source: The target has been beckoned by %s and is heeding the call. There is a %d%% chance of moving towards the beckoner each turn.
entries.target: 目标受到 %s 的召唤并响应其呼唤，每回合有 %d%% 概率向召唤者移动。

entries.source: Paranoia has gripped the target, causing a %d%% chance they will physically attack anyone nearby, friend or foe. Targets of the attack may become paranoid themselves.
entries.target: 目标被妄想纠缠，有 %d%% 概率以物理攻击附近任一目标，不分敌我，被攻击者也可能陷入妄想。

entries.source: The target has been panicked by %s, causing them to have a %d%% chance of fleeing in terror instead of acting.
entries.target: 目标对 %s 感到恐慌，使其有 %d%% 概率因为害怕而逃跑，无法正常行动。

entries.source: The target is lost in a nightmare that deals %0.2f darkness damage each turn and has a %d%% chance to cause a random detrimental effect.
entries.target: 目标陷入噩梦之中，每回合受到 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并有 %d%% 概率受到一个随机不良效果。

entries.source: The target is plagued by inner demons and each turn there's a %d%% chance that one will appear.  If the caster is killed or the target resists setting his demons loose the effect will end early.
entries.target: 目标被内心恶魔困扰，每回合有 %d%% 的几率出现一个恶魔。如果施法者被杀死，或目标抵抗而不释放自己的心魔，效果将提前结束。

entries.source: The target is asleep and unable to perform most actions.  Every %d damage it takes will reduce the duration of the effect by one turn.
entries.target: 目标陷入睡眠，无法执行大多数行动，每受到 %d 伤害缩短 1 回合持续时间。

entries.source: The target is in a deep sleep and unable to perform most actions.  Every %d damage it takes will reduce the duration of the effect by one turn.
entries.target: 目标陷入沉睡，无法执行大多数行动，每受到 %d 伤害缩短 1 回合持续时间。

entries.source: The target is in a nightmarish sleep, suffering %0.2f darkness damage each turn and unable to to perform most actions.  Every %d damage it takes will reduce the duration of the effect by one turn.
entries.target: 目标陷入噩梦般的沉睡，每回合受到 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并且无法执行大多数行动。每受到 %d 点伤害，效果持续时间便减少 1 回合。

entries.source: The target is infected with a mind parasite. Each time it uses a talent it has a %d%% chance to have %d random talent(s) put on cooldown for %d turns.
entries.target: 目标被精神寄生虫感染，每次使用技能时有 %d%% 几率让 %d 个随机技能进入 %d 回合的冷却。

entries.source: The target is doomed to die a bloody death.  Each time it uses an ability it takes %0.2f physical damage, and incoming bleeds are strengthened by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标注定要流血而死。每次使用技能时受到%0.2f物理伤害。接下来受到的流血效果增强 %d%%。

entries.source: The target is removed from the normal time stream, unable to act but unable to take any damage. Time does not pass for this creature.
entries.target: 目标被移出时间线，不能行动也不能受到伤害，该生物的时间停止。

entries.source: The target is surrounded by a time distortion, absorbing %d/%d damage and sending it forward in time. While active all newly applied status effects durations are reduced by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标被一层扭曲时空的护盾所包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害并将伤害向后推移。当激活时，所有新获得的负面状态（「其他」类除外）持续时间都会减少 %d%%。

entries.source: You veil yourself in shadows and let them control you. While in the veil you become immune to status effects, and gain %d%% all damage reduction. Each turn you blink to a nearby foe within range %d, hitting it for %d%% darkness weapon damage. While this goes on you cannot be stopped unless you are killed, and you cannot control your character.
entries.target: 你融入暗影并被其支配。笼罩在阴影中时，你对所有负面状态（「其他」类除外）免疫，并减少 %d%% 所受伤害；每回合你会闪现到半径 %d 内的一个敌人身边，对其造成 %d%% 暗影武器伤害。此技能激活期间，除非死亡，否则你无法被打断，且你无法控制你的角色。

entries.source:
An aura of death surrounds you.
#CRIMSON#Penalty : #WHITE#Fear of Death: %+d%% resistance against damage from the undead.
#CRIMSON#Power 1+: %sPower over Death: %+d%% damage against the undead.
#CRIMSON#Power 2+: %s%+d Luck, %+d Strength, %+d Magic
#CRIMSON#Power 3+: %sLiving Death: Ghoulish retch heals you. Once every %d turns, retch (level %d) when you fall below %d%% health
#CRIMSON#Power 4+: %sReprieve from Death: Humanoids you slay have a %d%% chance to rise to fight beside you as ghouls for 6 turns.
entries.target:
一个死亡的光环笼罩着你。
#CRIMSON# 惩罚：#WHITE# 死亡恐惧：%+d%% 对亡灵的伤害抗性。
#CRIMSON# 强度 1+：%s 死亡力量：%+d%% 对亡灵的伤害加成。
#CRIMSON# 强度 2+：%s%+d 幸运 , %+d 力量 , %+d 魔力
#CRIMSON# 强度 3+：%s 活死人之躯：腐秽呕吐能治疗你。每 %d 回合一次，当你生命值降至 %d%% 以下时，释放一次等级 %d 的腐秽呕吐。
#CRIMSON# 强度 4+：%s 死缓：你杀死的人形生物有 %d%% 几率变成食尸鬼并替你作战持续 6 回合。

entries.source:
You feel your grip on reality slipping.
#CRIMSON#Penalty : #WHITE#Fractured Sanity: %+d%% Mind Resistance, %+d%% Confusion Immunity
#CRIMSON#Power 1+: %sUnleashed: %+d%% critical damage, %+d%% off-hand weapon damage
#CRIMSON#Power 2+: %s%+d Luck, %+d Dexterity
#CRIMSON#Power 3+: %sConspirator: Your madness is contagious. Every time you critically damage a foe there is a %d%% chance to spread one of your current detrimental mental effect to them.
#CRIMSON#Power 4+: %sMania: Once per turn, when an attack does more than %0.1f%% of your life, the remaining cooldown of all your talents is reduced by 1.
entries.target:
你感到自己对现实的掌控正在松动。
#CRIMSON# 惩罚：#WHITE# 扰乱心智：%+d%% 精神抗性，%+d%% 混乱免疫
#CRIMSON# 强度 1+：%s 解除束缚：%+d%% 暴击伤害，%+d%% 副手武器伤害。
#CRIMSON# 强度 2+：%s%+d 幸运，%+d 敏捷
#CRIMSON# 强度 3+：%s 阴谋：你的疯狂是会传染的。每次你对敌人造成暴击伤害时，都有 %d%% 的几率将你当前的一种负面精神效果传播给对方。
#CRIMSON# 强度 4+：%s 狂热：每回合一次，当一次攻击超过你生命的 %0.1f%% 时，你所有技能的剩余冷却时间减少 1。

entries.source: Strength and Willpower are increased by %d. Poisons and diseases have a %d%% chance of being neutralized each turn.
entries.target: 力量和意志增加 %d。毒素和疾病每回合有 %d%% 几率被净化。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% cold damage, -10% cold resistance, -10% physical save, -20% confusion immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 寒冷伤害，-10% 寒冷抗性，-10% 物理豁免，-20% 混乱免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% lightning damage, -10% lightning resistance, -10% physical power, -20% stun immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 闪电伤害，-10% 闪电抗性，-10% 物理强度，-20% 震慑免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% acid damage, -10% acid resistance, -10% defense, -20% disarm immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 酸性伤害，-10% 酸性抗性，-10% 闪避，-20% 缴械免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% darkness damage, -10% darkness resistance, -10% mental save, -20% fear immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 暗影伤害，-10% 暗影抗性，-10% 精神豁免，-20% 恐惧免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% mind damage, -10% mind resistance, -10% spellpower, -20% silence immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 精神伤害，-10% 精神抗性，-10% 法术强度，-20% 沉默免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% light damage, -10% light resistance, -10% accuracy, -20% blind immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 光系伤害，-10% 光系抗性，-10% 命中，-20% 致盲免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% arcane damage, -10% arcane resistance, -10% armour hardiness, -20% stoning immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 奥术伤害，-10% 奥术抗性，-10% 护甲强度，-20% 石化免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% temporal damage, -10% temporal resistance, -10% spell save, -20% pinning immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 时空伤害，-10% 时空抗性，-10% 法术豁免，-20% 定身免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% physical damage, -10% physical resistance, -10% mindpower, -20% knockback immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 物理伤害，-10% 物理抗性，-10% 精神强度，-20% 击退免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% blight damage, -10% blight resistance, -20% healing mod, -20% disease immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 枯萎伤害，-10% 枯萎抗性，-20% 治疗加成，-20% 疾病免疫。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% nature damage, -10% nature resistance, -10% ranged defense, -20% poison immunity.
entries.target: 区域效果：+10% 自然伤害，-10% 自然抗性，-10% 远程闪避，-20% 毒素免疫。

entries.source: GODMODE: Target is invulnerable to damage, immune to bad status effects, deals +10000%% damage (100%% penetration), does not need to breathe, and has full ESP.
entries.target: 天神模式：目标不会受到伤害，不会受到负面状态的影响，造成 +10000%% 伤害（100%% 抗性穿透），不需要呼吸，感应所有生物。

entries.source: To complete your resurrection you must kill a unique/boss/elite boss rank creature before the duration expires.
entries.target: 为了完成你的复活，你必须在持续时间结束前，杀死一个 史诗/Boss/精英Boss 等级的敌人。

entries.source: A flow of life spins around the target, regenerating %0.2f life per turn.
entries.target: 生命之流环绕目标，每回合回复 %0.2f 生命值。

entries.source: The target is poisoned and sick, doing %0.2f nature damage per turn. Each time it tries to use a talent there is %d%% chance of failure.
entries.target: 目标中毒且患病，每回合受到 %0.2f 自然伤害，每次使用技能时有 %d%% 概率失败。

entries.source: The target is taking %0.2f nature damage per turn from a potent earth-based poison.  In %d more turn(s), or when the poison has run its course (%d%% chance), the target will be turned to stone for %d turns.
entries.target: 目标每回合受到来自强效土系毒素的 %0.2f 自然伤害。在 %d 回合后，或者毒素效果结束时（%d%% 几率），目标将被石化 %d 回合。

entries.source: The target is encased in ice. All damage done to it will be split, 40%% absorbed by the ice and 60%% by the target. The target's defense is nullified while in the ice, and it may only attack the ice, but it is also immune to any new detrimental status effects (except Wet and Frozen Feet). The target cannot teleport or heal while frozen. %d HP on the iceblock remaining.
entries.target: 目标被冻结在冰块中，对其造成的所有伤害有 40%%被冰块吸收，目标则受到余下的 60%%伤害。冰冻状态下其闪避无效，只能攻击冰块，但同时免疫新的负面状态（湿润和冻足除外）。目标被冻结时无法传送也不能回复生命。冰块剩余 %d HP。

entries.source: The target calls upon its inner resources, improving all damage by %d%% and reducing all damage taken by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标召唤其内心的力量，提高所有伤害加成%d%%，减少受到的所有伤害%d%%。

entries.source: The target is infused with the power of nature, reducing all blight damage taken by %d%%, increasing spell saves by %d, and granting immunity to diseases.
entries.target: 目标得到了自然的力量，受到的所有枯萎伤害减少 %d%%，提升法术豁免 %d，并使其对疾病免疫。

entries.source: Moving at extreme speed (%d%% faster) and gains 100%% stun, daze and pinning immunity. Any action other than movement will cancel it.
entries.target: 以极快的速度移动 (加速 %d%%) 并获得 100%% 震慑、眩晕和定身免疫。任何非移动动作都会取消这一效果。

entries.source: Each melee blow landed has a %d%% chance to trigger an additional melee blow (up to once per turn for each weapon).
entries.target: 每次近战命中都有 %d%% 几率触发额外一击（每回合每把武器至多一次）。

entries.source: The target gains %d%% stun, daze and pinning immunity.
entries.target: 目标获得 %d%% 震慑、眩晕、定身免疫。

entries.source: Parrying melee%s attacks: Has a %d%% chance to deflect up to %d damage from the next %0.1f attack(s).  Parried attacks cannot crit.
entries.target: 招架近战%s攻击：有 %d%% 几率偏转接下来攻击中的至多 %d 点伤害（剩余 %0.1f 次）。被招架的攻击不会暴击。

entries.source: The target is covered in slippery moss. Each time it tries to use a talent there is %d%% chance of failure.
entries.target: 目标被光滑苔藓覆盖，每次使用技能时有 %d%% 几率失败。

entries.source: Target is currently moving with %d%% additional speed in a single direction (%s). Stopping or changing directions will remove this effect.
entries.target: 目标单方向（%s）移动时获得 %d%% 额外速度。停止或者改变方向将取消此效果。

entries.source: It is silenced for the next %d turn(s), preventing it from casting spells and using some vocal talents.
entries.target: 目标还会被沉默 %d 回合，无法施放法术或使用部分发声类技能。

entries.source: The target is reeling in pain. Stun, pin, blindness, and confusion immunity are halved and physical save is reduced by %d.
entries.target: 目标在痛苦中挣扎，震慑、定身、目盲、混乱免疫减半，物理豁免减少 %d。

entries.source: The target protects all those around it in radius %d by redirecting all damage against them to itself.
entries.target: 目标保护身边半径 %d 内所有友方生物，将伤害转移至自身。

entries.source: %d%% chance to fully evade any damaging actions or negative effects.
entries.target: %d%%几率躲闪任何伤害或负面效果。
